title: Input wire encoding
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet, and let $n,s$ be natural numbers. For a position $p\in\{0,\ldots,n+1\}$, encode it by the input bit with index $p-1$ when $1\le p\le n$; otherwise encode it by the summary bit indexed by false.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet
